from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import List, Optional

class PermitRecord(BaseModel):
    """Monthly permit data extracted from a single report, including metadata for conflict resolution."""
    month: Optional[str] = Field(description="Month in YYYY-MM format")
    report_release_date: Optional[str] = Field(description="Release date of the report (YYYY-MM-DD) to determine precedence")
    report_number: Optional[str] = Field(description="Official Census release number (e.g., CB22-156)")
    northeast_saar: Optional[float] = Field(description="Seasonally adjusted annual rate for the Northeast region")
    midwest_saar: Optional[float] = Field(description="Seasonally adjusted annual rate for the Midwest region")
    unit: Optional[str] = Field(description="Unit of the rate values (e.g., 'thousand', 'thousand units')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Container for all extracted permit records from the document collection."""
    records: List[PermitRecord] = Field(description="List of monthly permit data records")
